Metadata.title: MoneyWorks | A clearer view of your money
Metadata.description: Plan financial independence with pension age ranges and planned portfolio drawdown. A country-neutral FIRE calculator in English and Swedish.

intro.title: A clearer view of your money.
intro.description: A little understanding can change the way you see your finances. We're building the tools to help you find it.
intro.asideTitle: Different questions. One place to start.

tools.title: Tools with a purpose.
tools.description: Start planning your future. More tools are on the way.

fire.title: FIRE calculator
fire.description: Put your financial independence plans into perspective, one scenario at a time.
fire.context: For the life you want to build.
items: Portfolio needed or the first funded retirement age.
Government and employer pensions with custom payout ages.
Planned drawdown or preserving capital at the plan end.
fire.note: Runs in this page with explicit assumptions. No account needed, no saved plans and no promise about future returns.

crypto.title: Crypto tax calculator
crypto.description: Bring some order to your trading history and the questions that come with it.
crypto.context: For the details that need a clearer picture.
items: An organised view of your crypto-trading activity.
Calculations with the chosen rules clearly explained.
Explicit country support, without guessing where you file.
crypto.note: Not available yet. Supported countries and tax methods have not been selected.

learn.title: A little context goes a long way.
learn.description: Good tools should make things easier to understand, not give you another set of numbers to decipher.

items.question: What is MoneyWorks?
items.answer: A growing home for personal finance tools and straightforward information. We're starting with financial independence planning and crypto-trading tax calculations, with room for more useful tools over time.

items.question: Can I use the calculators yet?
items.answer: The FIRE calculator is available below the tool panels. It needs JavaScript for local calculations; its explanation is pre-rendered. The crypto tax calculator is still planned. FIRE inputs are not sent to a server or saved.

items.question: Is the site for a particular country?
items.answer: MoneyWorks is country-neutral and available in English and Swedish. When a tool needs country-specific rules, supported countries and assumptions will be stated explicitly.

about.title: More perspective. Less noise.
about.description: Personal finance is personal. MoneyWorks is being built around clear explanations, useful tools and space to think, without assuming your currency, country or next move.

footer.description: A useful place to think about your money.
footer.note: A work in progress, with a clear direction.
